concerns.text: T004 says "using `pyEntropy`/`EntropyHub`-style sample entropy" — the actual library is ambiguous. plan.md pins `pyentropy==0.4.*` only. An implementer cannot deterministically pick the package (APIs differ: pyEntropy's `sample_entropy` vs EntropyHub's `SampEn`). Name the single library and the exact function to call.

T005 says outputs conform to "entropy.schema.yaml" but two near-duplicate contracts exist (entropy.schema.yaml vs entropy_schema.schema.yaml) with different required fields (the latter requires metadata.includes_noise_variance, referencing a nonexistent FR-009). The implementer cannot know which contract validation targets; T005's metadata list (n_subjects, n_parcels, scales, r_values, seed) omits includes_noise_variance. Designate the governing schema per output.

"a deterministic fixed-seed subset of up to N=200 subjects" does not specify the selection procedure: which seed, drawn from which subject list, and in what order. Without this, two implementers produce different cohorts and the T014 byte-identical re-run claim is unverifiable. Specify e.g. seed 42 over the sorted HCP subject-ID list.

T006 expects `data/derived/covariates.parquet` from `run_pipeline.py`, but T005 (which defines the pipeline entry point and its outputs) never lists covariates.parquet among its artifacts, and no task explicitly implements its generation. Add the producer (e.g. in T003's QC output or T005's pipeline) so T006 has a defined input.

T011 says "re-running the model" per grid point without naming which model — MixedLM (T007) or the OLS fallback? Given 12 grid points × 400 parcels, MixedLM refits may blow the time budget the task itself imposes. Specify the model form and confirm the 1000-permutation budget accounts for it.

T012 creates `code/src/reporting/figures.py`, but `reporting/` is not in T001's required directory tree. Add it to T001's list (or note T012 creates it) so the T001 directory-existence validation is consistent.
